headline: Latent variables unify hippocampal time and place coding and contextual learning
label: Hippocampal Latent Structure Modeling
summary: Recent models explain hippocampal time, place, and latent learning phenomena through latent-variable representations and explicit behavioural statistics.
synthesis: The dominant thread is that latent variables, carried in recurrent CA3 dynamics, in integrated feature and outcome representations, or in predictive successor representations, account for hippocampal phenomena. A recurrent CA3 autoencoder yields both place and time cell representations, suggesting a shared origin with task-driven differences. A joint feature- and outcome-based model overcomes the limits of each alone and reproduces PFC-hippocampus behavioural and cellular phenomena in contextual inference. A deep successor representation account models latent learning in spatial navigation, where pre-exposure exploration aligned with reward location is reported to speed later learning and sensitivity to behavioural statistics is explicit. What is new is the unification of time and place coding within one network and the explicit treatment of behavioural statistics in latent learning. The items do not directly compare these models against one another.
